tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to cut off, reserve, lay aside, leave, save
1a) (Qal) to reserve
(Piel) to break bones, gnaw bones, break

tbesh_html: (Piel) to break bones, gnaw bones, break

strongs_1890.strongs_def: (causative) to bone, i.e. denude (by extensive, craunch) the bones
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; to be spare or skeleton-like; used only as a denominative from H1634 (גֶּרֶם);
